title: BEAVII
tagline: AI ETF Portfolio Management suite that’s target user is influencers, fund managers, & Investors.
description: We are a AI ETF Portfolio Management suite that’s allows anyone to become a etf fund manager, our target users are influencers, fund managers, & investors. A manager can create their own fund of tokens on $Flow, and bridge some of those assets back and forth to $Base for more variety of assets. We are utilizing Privy’s new Developer Controlled Wallets with compatibility with the $Flow blockchain.
how_its_made:
We are using $Flow as our master blockchain for our Killer Dapp and $Base as a slave, to add more functionality and compatibility to offer more token options to our community. We do this by utilizing Privy’s Developer controlled wallet feature, allowing us to utilize AI to bridge liquidity across chains, swap them back & forth, there & back. We are using the Flare Time Series Oracle (FTSO) for pricing feeds for our ETF Funds. We are also using The Flare Data Connector (FDC) for social verification via X.com. Therefore users can verify their fund managers social proof and do their due diligence on the fund managers. 

Webhooks for connecting a embedded wallet to a server wallet,

We are using MS SQL for our database and storing the coupling of this data.

Relay for bridging
